title: 考场就座
summary: 考场有 n 个座位，每次学生选择到最近他人距离最大且编号最小的空位，并支持指定学生离开。
insight: 维护已占座位有序集合；选座时比较首段、相邻已占座位中点和尾段的最大最近距离，并用严格大于更新保证并列取较小编号。
pitfalls: 中间间隔的最近距离是 gap/2
尾段并列时较大编号不能覆盖已有候选

solutions.title: 有序占座集合间隔扫描
solutions.idea: 每次扫描所有占座位置选出最优空位。
steps: candidate=0，bestDistance=firstSeat；扫描相邻座位，若 gap/2 严格更大则 candidate=previous+gap/2
若 n-1-lastSeat 严格更大则选 n-1；加入 occupied 并返回，leave 时删除

complexity.time: O(s) per seat, O(log s) leave

code.java: class ExamRoom { private final int n;private final TreeSet<Integer> occupied=new TreeSet<>();public ExamRoom(int n){this.n=n;}public int seat(){if(occupied.isEmpty()){occupied.add(0);return 0;}int candidate=0,best=occupied.first(),previous=occupied.first();for(int current:occupied.tailSet(previous,false)){int distance=(current-previous)/2;if(distance>best){best=distance;candidate=previous+distance;}previous=current;}if(n-1-previous>best)candidate=n-1;occupied.add(candidate);return candidate;}public void leave(int p){occupied.remove(p);} }
code.kotlin: class ExamRoom(private val n:Int){private val occupied=java.util.TreeSet<Int>();fun seat():Int{if(occupied.isEmpty()){occupied.add(0);return 0};var candidate=0;var best=occupied.first();var previous=occupied.first();for(current in occupied.tailSet(previous,false)){val distance=(current-previous)/2;if(distance>best){best=distance;candidate=previous+distance};previous=current};if(n-1-previous>best)candidate=n-1;occupied.add(candidate);return candidate};fun leave(p:Int){occupied.remove(p)} }
code.cpp: class ExamRoom { int n;set<int> occupied;public:ExamRoom(int n):n(n){}int seat(){if(occupied.empty()){occupied.insert(0);return 0;}int candidate=0,best=*occupied.begin(),previous=*occupied.begin();for(auto it=next(occupied.begin());it!=occupied.end();++it){int distance=(*it-previous)/2;if(distance>best){best=distance;candidate=previous+distance;}previous=*it;}if(n-1-previous>best)candidate=n-1;occupied.insert(candidate);return candidate;}void leave(int p){occupied.erase(p);} };
